parties.party_name: Alliance for the Union of Romanians
Democratic Alliance of Hungarians in Romania

note: Pro-European grand coalition (PSD + PNL + UDMR, 'with the support of the national minorities') inaugurated 23 December 2024 with 240/465 votes. 'National minorities' is an aggregate of 19 distinct single-seat ethnic-minority organizations rather than one party; wikidata_id (Q1904908) is for the collective 'National Minority parliamentary group' concept, confirmed to exist as its own Wikidata item on a later pass.
